title: Post-Monsoon t-SNE Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction & Linear Comparison

linear_vs_nonlinear_insights.interpretation: t-SNE achieves higher local neighborhood preservation (trustworthiness) by unrolling nonlinear manifold curvature in mixed-phase and convective transition boundaries, while linear PCA (PC1 vs PC2) preserves global variance and orthogonal physical cloud regimes.
